watches.name: Prometheus Jamanta White Dial  No Date Miyota 9039
watches.description: Dive into the mesmerizing fusion of style and performance with the Jamanta Diver Watch, a prized microbrand offering by the esteemed Prometheus Watch Company. A testament to the perfect blend of design and functionality, this microbrand timepiece signifies the brand's relentless dedication to superior craftsmanship and inventive design. More than just a watch, the Jamanta Diver is an impeccably crafted tool designed for the audacious explorers of aquatic realms. This microbrand timepiece is your reliable partner, enduring the test of time and exploration, inspiring you to dive confidently into the ocean's enchanting depths. The allure of this microbrand watch extends beyond its aesthetic appeal, promising unrivaled functionality. Ticking with unwavering precision at its core is the dependable Miyota 9015 movement for the date model or the equally reliable Miyota 9039 for the no-date version, encapsulating every fleeting moment with immaculate accuracy. The Jamanta Diver Watch invites you to a timekeeping experience that transcends the ordinary. This microbrand timepiece doesn't merely track time; it weaves a fascinating tapestry of moments, all ready to be explored by you. Technical Features: Case Dimensions: 42.50mm x 50.40mm Dial Opening: 33.00mm Lug Width: 22.00 mm Height including crystal and case back 13.30mm Water Resistance: Up to 300 meters Movement: Miyota 9015 (Date Models) / Miyota 9039 (No Date Models) Case: 316L Stainless Steel Sapphire crystal with anti reflective coating applied inside Lume: BGW9 applied to Dial, Hands Bracelet: 316L Stainless Steel with quick adjustment clasp Discover the Jamanta Diver Watch - a compelling microbrand embodiment of the audacious spirit of the Prometheus Watch Company. This isn't just a watch; it's your reliable ally for thrilling aquatic adventures. Experience the exceptional quality and uniqueness that a microbrand watch offers with the Jamanta Diver Watch.
